mapper.select: WITH people AS (), own_combos AS ( SELECT p.* FROM playlist p JOIN people u ON u.id = p.user_id ) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM people) AS people_total, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM people WHERE email LIKE 'beta-%@beta.asmrblock.com') AS beta_guests, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM people WHERE email NOT LIKE 'beta-%@beta.asmrblock.com') AS members, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM people x WHERE = ) AS new_today, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM people WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days') AS new_7d, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM own_combos WHERE source_playlist_id IS NULL) AS combos, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM own_combos WHERE source_playlist_id IS NULL AND created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days') AS combos_7d, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM own_combos WHERE source_playlist_id IS NULL AND is_public = true) AS public_combos, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM own_combos WHERE source_playlist_id IS NOT NULL) AS collects, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM play_log WHERE played_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours') AS plays_24h, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM play_log WHERE played_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days') AS plays_7d, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM play_log) AS plays_total, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM block WHERE is_active = true AND status = 'APPROVED') AS approved_blocks, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM block b JOIN users u ON u.id = b.uploader_id WHERE b.is_active = true AND b.status = 'APPROVED' AND u.email = 'samples@asmrblock.invalid') AS sample_blocks, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM block b JOIN people u ON u.id = b.uploader_id WHERE b.is_active = true) AS user_uploads, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM block WHERE is_active = true AND status = 'PENDING') AS pending_blocks, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM feedback WHERE is_done = false) AS new_feedback, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT (target_type, target_id)) FROM report WHERE status = 'OPEN') AS open_reports

WITH cohort AS ( SELECT p.id, p.created_at, ((p.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date) AS joined_day FROM () p WHERE p.created_at >= NOW() - (#{days} * INTERVAL '1 day') ) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cohort) AS joined, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cohort c WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_block ub WHERE ub.user_id = c.id AND ub.source = 'FREE' AND ub.acquired_at > c.created_at)) AS collected, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cohort c WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM playlist p WHERE p.user_id = c.id)) AS has_combo, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cohort c WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM playlist p WHERE p.user_id = c.id AND p.source_playlist_id IS NULL)) AS made_combo, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cohort c WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM playlist p WHERE p.user_id = c.id AND p.source_playlist_id IS NOT NULL)) AS collected_combo, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cohort c WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM play_log l WHERE l.user_id = c.id AND l.target_type = 'PLAYLIST')) AS listened, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cohort c WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM listen_log l WHERE l.user_id = c.id AND l.minutes >= 10)) AS listened_10m, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cohort c WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_activity_day a WHERE a.user_id = c.id AND a.day > c.joined_day)) AS came_back, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cohort c WHERE c.joined_day < ) AS can_come_back

WITH days AS ( SELECT generate_series( - 13, , INTERVAL '1 day')::date AS d ), people AS (), signups AS (SELECT AS d, COUNT(*) AS n FROM people x GROUP BY 1), combos AS (SELECT AS d, COUNT(*) AS n FROM playlist x JOIN people u ON u.id = x.user_id WHERE x.source_playlist_id IS NULL GROUP BY 1), plays AS (SELECT ((played_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date) AS d, COUNT(*) AS n FROM play_log GROUP BY 1) SELECT days.d AS date, COALESCE(s.n, 0) AS signups, COALESCE(c.n, 0) AS combos, COALESCE(p.n, 0) AS plays FROM days LEFT JOIN signups s ON s.d = days.d LEFT JOIN combos c ON c.d = days.d LEFT JOIN plays p ON p.d = days.d ORDER BY days.d
